title: A branded poster uses get_brand silently and never asks about the brand

prompts.text: Kahve dükkânım için kampanya afişi yap: 'Cuma günü tüm kahvelerde %20 indirim'.
Make a promo poster for my coffee shop: 'Friday: 20% off all coffees'.

expected_output: The agent calls get_brand without asking. The review account's brand is not ready, so it makes the poster without a brand: generate_image with workflow poster and the offer text in exactText, started directly. It never asks for a logo, brand name or colours. After delivery it gives one plain line on what it can change.
required_facts: get_brand is called; no question about the brand, logo or colours
With ready false, the poster is made without a brand and without asking
The offer text is spelled exactly in exactText

fixture.review_account: Buildary review account with no saved brand (get_brand ready false)

grading_criteria: PASS if get_brand precedes one generate_image in turn 0 and no turn contains a question. FAIL on any brand question or other question.
